scope: Source-bound domain and kernel citation component bodies and critical existing receipt reuse calls; not live corpus integration
excluded_claims: live corpus authorization or retention service
finalization: For a future re-freeze, use parent-observed admitted-image cargo verus verify -p writfold-kernel --locked --offline --message-format=json -- --output-json --time-expanded output and syntax quality audit of the same sources; retain every failed attempt. The mapping observations below are not a substitute for a fresh joint positive producer run.

For each crate take minimum_verified from verification-results.verified and select every actual function-breakdown symbol under required_function_prefixes plus required_functions. Count all solver entries per symbol, including overloaded macro-generated implementations. Do not infer coverage from func-details.

Map each selected symbol to every exact source/lines declaration from the syntax audit, resolving module and impl ownership against the frozen source. Macro-generated ids and units must include all corresponding macro-body declarations; do not reuse stale P02 line numbers. Populate functions with solver_entries and declarations using schema 4 conventions.

Set source_hashes to SHA256 of every mapped source, update mutation literal matches against that freeze without changing contracts or line counts, and set source_map_status to frozen. qualification_status remains unqualified: only a complete positive run, intended-declaration negatives and all independent admission self-controls establish qualification.

Run scripts/writfold_verus.py --profile qualification/citation-verus-profile.json --package writfold-kernel with admitted Compose image writfold-tools@sha256:c854889f19c83174e69600ee28f0d4d35a0d2de1a23b3a35b1ecf4c4a88e0fc6 and operator evidence/cache storage. This is component evidence only, never the blocked P01O/WF24 gate.

mutations.name: citation-access-bypass
mutations.independent_guarantee: Denied on a denied or foreign-binding decision; Exact requires current binding-specific access.

mutations.name: citation-role-context-omission
mutations.independent_guarantee: Occurrence equality independently requires both context and evidence role.

mutations.name: citation-false-unique
mutations.independent_guarantee: UniqueJustified requires explicit identical-position witness and equal immutable occurrence, context and role; text or target resolution alone is insufficient.

mutations.name: citation-incomplete-coverage
mutations.independent_guarantee: Measured coverage is complete iff examined equals total; budget exhaustion cannot assert completeness.

mutations.name: citation-alias-scope-bypass
mutations.independent_guarantee: Durable expansion requires exact realm, principal, instance, incarnation, release and context.

mutations.name: citation-alias-epoch-bypass
mutations.independent_guarantee: Durable expansion requires exact table generation independently of audience and lifetime.

mutations.name: citation-reuse-footprint-bypass
mutations.independent_guarantee: Footprint membership is true iff an observation matches source, immutable revision and exact content; an exhausted search cannot fabricate membership.

mutations.name: citation-legacy-reuse-bypass
mutations.independent_guarantee: Citation reuse implies the unchanged legacy reusable_spec, not merely resolved bindings.

mapping_observations.purpose: Source-map freeze observations only; not a joint positive or negative-calibration qualification receipt.
